title: Miles Allowed for Each Day of a Car Rental Belonging to a Holiday
content:
The miles allowed for each day of a rental on the Car Rental Rate Classes are decided by the holiday the hire belongs to, read from the vacation package the renter holds on the Vacation Package Products: whether it is under way or finished, and how many nights it runs.

**The allowance schedule.**

| The vacation package the renter holds | Miles allowed for each day |
|---|---|
| Standing at travelling or completed, running 7 nights or more | 220 |
| Standing at travelling or completed, running fewer than 7 nights | 165 |
| No such package held | The rate class's own included miles |

**Both parts of each condition.** Each of the first two entitlements requires the standing and the nights together. A package on the Vacation Package Products standing at travelling that runs 7 nights carries 220 miles for each day; standing at completed and running 7 nights, likewise 220. Running 6 nights on either standing, it carries 165. A package standing at anything other than travelling or completed is not a package the schedule names, and the rental then carries the rate class's own included miles, however many nights that package runs.

**The boundary on the nights.** At exactly 7 nights the allowance is 220 miles for each day, the band opening at that figure; at 6 nights it is 165.

**Illustration on hypothetical holdings.** A renter whose vacation package stands at completed over 10 nights carries 220 miles for each day of the hire. A renter whose package stands at travelling over 4 nights carries 165. A renter holding no vacation package at all carries the included miles published for the rate class booked.
